notes: Background: Rivermark builds a customer analytics UI + automated insights (SaaS). Heavily interactive product recommendations and in-app help -- latency sensitive.
Initial onboarding: started on Redwood Hosted API (Q3 trial). Good dev DX, quick proof-of-concept for embeddings + doc-search. Now evaluating Dedicated for predictable throughput and data separation.
Key stakeholders: VP Eng (Tom Keane), Head of Platform (Priya Malhotra), SecOps (Jared Lee), Product Manager (Renee Ortiz). AE: Maya Rodriguez, SE: Ethan Park, CSM: Lina Gomez.
Quote from Tom on 2025-10-07 call: 'If Dedicated doesn't beat our hosted latency tail and unit cost by end of POC, we can't justify new commit.'
Commercial sensitivity: target ARR band 50k-150k; procurement will push on pricing floors and burst capacity terms.
Security ask: must support SSO/SAML, KMS-backed key management, audit logs exported to their SIEM, and option for EU data residency for some customers.

Workload profile: mix of short-form chat (support bot) plus high-volume embeddings for search/retrieval. Expected steady-state 80-120 reqs/sec during spike windows, average request token length ~120 tokens.
Latency targets: p50 ~80-120ms, p95 <350ms for chat; embeddings p95 <200ms. Cost target: reduce per-embedding unit cost by ~30% vs hosted baseline.

POC ask: 4-week Dedicated POC with canary rollout (5% -> 25% -> 75% -> 100%), model variant fallback (quantized smaller model + higher-cost large model), region failover (us-east -> us-west -> eu-west), automatic rollback triggers.
Monitoring/metrics: want Redwood Console hooks + prometheus exporter + alerting when tail latency exceeds thresholds or accuracy regressions detected on eval prompt set.
Evaluation criteria: latency SLOs, unit cost delta, ease of routing & rollout (canary), security checklist completion, support responsiveness on kernel/quantization tuning.

Technical constraints noted by Platform team: existing networking limits egress to specific subnets, need clear runbook for VPC peering and NAT gateway config. Also ask for documented kernel choices for their GPU fleet (A10G).

POC success metrics captured in drive doc: 'POC-Metrics-Rev1' (linked). JD: canary progression must show stable p95 and no accuracy drop vs hosted; if error rate >1% or p95 increases >25% => auto rollback.
Internal red flags: SecOps flagged 'data residency' clause for marketing analytics customers in EU - will require EU-region Dedicated or Private deployment for those customers only.
Commercial next: Pricing worksheet shared 2025-10-15 (drive). AE notes: customer prefers monthly ramp vs annual commit if possible.

SE notes from lab run (2025-10-29): 1) quantized variant (int8 q4) reduces GPU memory by ~50%, 2) small model fallback increases latency slightly but reduces cost 40% — need to validate quality on reranking set.
Ask from Product: want canary + fallback demo showing traffic split rules, model routing by latency budget, and region failover in Redwood Console.
Next interactions: security deep-dive scheduled 2025-11-04; pricing negotiation call tentatively 2025-11-10.
Misc: Jira for POC engineering tasks created (RDW-2114) and follow-up for quantization tuning (RDW-2189).
